hip, and shoulder) are tougher than those
from the center of the animal — the rib,
loin, or breast.

relax and increase in acidity — a natural
way to tenderize meat — and muscle pro-
teins increase their water-holding ability,
which enhances juiciness.
Aging is a process that relaxes the tissues,
making the beef easier to chew and enjoy.
The original process of aging, now called
dry-aging, demanded that a carcass hang in
a cooler for 3 weeks or more.  The surface
would dry out and be thrown away.  The
remaining beef made excellent but expen-
sive steaks.  This process is now reserved for
steaks bound for only the best steakhouses.
